description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en: ClientToken ensures request idempotence. Generate a unique parameter value from your client for each request. ClientToken only supports ASCII characters. If you do not specify it, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken identity. The RequestId for each API request may differ.

description.zh: 合同比对场景下使用，第一次上传文件会返回ContractId，如果需要比对，则第二次上传传递该参数并上传标准文档
description.en: Used in contract comparison scenarios. The first file upload returns a ContractId. If comparison is needed, pass this parameter during the second upload and upload the standard document.

description.zh: 上传文件的下载url。需要通过文件直接上传的请使用SDK的CreateFileAdvanceRequest请求
description.en: Download URL of the uploaded file. To upload files directly, use the CreateFileAdvanceRequest from the SDK.

description.zh: 阿里云百炼平台工作空间ID
description.en: Workspace ID for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

descriptions.zh:
- 该接口需要开通法睿商品相关的后付费服务（开通免费），可以使用该账号的AccessKey和AccessSecret来调用我们的OpenApi服务

- 接口的调用需要阿里云百炼平台的工作空间权限。
descriptions.en:
- Activate the pay-as-you-go service for Farui products. Activation is free. Use your account’s AccessKey and AccessSecret to invoke the OpenAPI service.

- You must have workspace permissions for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio to invoke this API.
